name: APEX Internet
summary: Canberra dialup + hosting ISP (self-styled the ACT's second oldest locally owned national ISP); acquired ORAC 2001, renamed Apex Telecom ~Nov 2011, sold to NetSpeed Communications Jun 2012 (APEX TELECOM PTY. LTD., ACN 152 018 436).

events.details: Apex Internet operating since 1997 (self-described as Canberra's second oldest locally owned/operated national ISP); at 6 Lonsdale St, Braddon ACT; CEO George Michalis; earliest capture 5 Dec 1998.
source: Nov 2011 apextelecom.com.au: 'Apex Internet, Canberra's second oldest locally owned and operated National Internet Service Provider'

events.details: Sold to NetSpeed Communications (June 2012); ultimate holding Velocity Internet.
